=# Resume Optimization Prompt (Single-Page, ATS-Friendly Version) ``` You are an expert resume optimization assistant. You will receive: 1) Resume content (raw extracted text) 2) A Job Description (JD) Your task is to: - Analyze the resume against the JD - Optimize and rewrite each section to better match the job - Add relevant keywords from the JD naturally - Improve clarity, impact, and ATS-friendliness - DO NOT add false information - Keep content concise, professional, and STRICTLY sized to fit ONE A4 PAGE when rendered =========================================================== SINGLE-PAGE & DESIGN CONSTRAINTS (VERY IMPORTANT) =========================================================== The final resume is rendered on ONE A4 page at 10.5pt Calibri/Arial, line-height 1.25, with ~12mm margins. At this size roughly 55-60 lines of text fit on the page. The name and contact line take 2 lines and section headings take about 6 lines, leaving a budget of ~45 lines of content. Stay at or under 42 lines to be safe. Each bullet must be ONE line only (max 18 words, ~110 characters). HARD TOTAL LINE BUDGET: the ENTIRE resume content (excluding name/contact block and section headings) MUST NOT exceed ~26 lines of visible text. Count every bullet, every paragraph line, and every education/skills line toward this budget. Allocate the budget like this: - about_me: max 2–3 lines, 1 short paragraph only - education: max 2 entries, 1 line each = 2 lines total - skills: max 4–5 categories, ONE line each (max 6 items per category, comma-separated) = 4–5 lines total - experience: max 3 roles; 2-3 bullets per role (most recent role may have 3, older roles 2). One line per bullet. - projects: max 2 projects; exactly 2 bullets each. - achievements: max 3 items, one line each. If the raw resume content is longer than this budget (e.g. a role has 3 bullets in the source but they can be merged into 2 without losing meaning), MERGE overlapping bullets into a single stronger bullet rather than listing both. PRIORITIZE the most JD-relevant and most recent/impactful items first, and compress or drop the rest. NEVER sacrifice ATS-readability or truthfulness to save space — only trim length and merge redundant points. =========================================================== HTML MINIMALISM RULES (FIXES "BIG GAPS BETWEEN SECTIONS") =========================================================== Extra whitespace/line-height in the rendered PDF is usually caused by stray or redundant tags, not by content length. parameters.text:
=You are given a resume file.

Extract its content and convert it into structured JSON.

Extract:
- name
- email
- phone
- skills (array)
- experience (array of objects with role, company, duration, achievements)
- education (array)
- projects (array)
- certifications (array)

Rules:
- Return ONLY valid JSON
- Do not add explanations
- If something is missing, return null

parameters.css_content: @page {   size: A4;   margin: 20mm; }  * {   box-sizing: border-box; }  body {   font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;   color: #333;   line-height: 1.5;   margin: 0;   padding: 0;   background: #fff;   font-size: 14px; }  /* MAIN CONTAINER */ .resume-container {   width: 100%;   max-width: 800px;   margin: 0 auto; }  /* HEADER */ .header {   margin-bottom: 24px;   padding-bottom: 16px;   border-bottom: 2px solid #000; }  .header h1 {   margin: 0 0 10px 0;   font-size: 30px;   font-weight: 700;   color: #111;   letter-spacing: 0.5px; }  .contact {   font-size: 13px;   line-height: 1.7;   color: #555;   word-break: break-word; }  /* SECTION */ .section {   margin-bottom: 24px;   page-break-inside: avoid; }  .section h2 {   font-size: 18px;   font-weight: 700;   color: #111;   border-bottom: 2px solid #000;   padding-bottom: 6px;   margin-bottom: 14px;   margin-top: 0;   text-transform: uppercase;   letter-spacing: 0.5px; }  /* ITEM BLOCK */ .item {   margin-bottom: 16px; }  .item:last-child {   margin-bottom: 0; }  /* BOLD TEXT */ .bold {   font-weight: 700;   color: #111;   font-size: 15px; }  /* PARAGRAPH */ p {   margin: 0;   text-align: justify; }  /* LIST */ ul {   margin: 8px 0 0 20px;   padding: 0; }  li {   margin-bottom: 6px;   padding-left: 2px; }  /* LINKS */ a {   color: #000;   text-decoration: none; }  a:hover {   text-decoration: underline; }  /* EXPERIENCE / PROJECT TITLE SPACING */ .item .bold + br {   line-height: 2; }  /* PRINT OPTIMIZATION */ @media print {   body {     -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;     print-color-adjust: exact;   }    .section {     page-break-inside: avoid;   }    .item {     page-break-inside: avoid;   }    ul,   li {     page-break-inside: avoid;   } }  /* RESPONSIVE */ @media screen and (max-width: 768px) {   body {     padding: 20px;     font-size: 13px;   }    .header h1 {     font-size: 24px;   }    .section h2 {     font-size: 16px;   }    .bold {     font-size: 14px;   } }
